positions.as_written: Measure on a sagittal image or a true lateral radiograph, since the measurement is sagittal.
Keep the flexion angle consistent, because patellar height changes through flexion.
Use a ratio, so that magnification and patient size cancel.
State which ratio was used, because several exist and their thresholds differ.
Assess the cartilaginous articular surfaces where the ratio depends on them, which magnetic resonance imaging allows and a radiograph does not.
The measurement must be reported with its convention or the surgeon cannot compare it with a threshold.
